Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::BaseURL
Setting.Description: Address of the Tiqora installation, without a trailing path (for example https://tiqora.example.org). Links from Znuny to Tiqora are built from it.

Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::AgentCIPath
Setting.Description: Path of a configuration item in the Tiqora agent interface; the CI id is appended.

Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::CustomerCIPath
Setting.Description: Path of a configuration item in the Tiqora customer portal; the CI id is appended.

Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::ReadOnly::Force
Setting.Description: Treat the CMDB as read-only in Znuny even when Tiqora has not set the flag.

Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::ReadOnly::Actions
Setting.Description: Znuny screens for configuration items that are refused while the CMDB is read-only. An entry is an action name (the whole screen) or Action::Subaction (one subaction). Read screens (zoom, search, history, print, attachment download) are not listed. AgentLinkObject is guarded by the module itself: it refuses to link to or from configuration items.

Setting.Name: PreApplicationModule###TiqoraITSMReadOnly
Setting.Description: Refuses the Znuny screens that change configuration items once the CMDB is read-only because Tiqora holds it (TiqoraITSM::ReadOnly::Actions).

Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::Linking::Enabled
Setting.Description: Allow agents to link tickets to CIs of Tiqora from the ticket zoom (needs TiqoraITSM::APIKey).

Setting.Name: TiqoraITSM::APIKey
Setting.Description: API key of a dedicated Tiqora user with the area cmdb:rw. The key is visible to everyone who can read the system configuration or a support bundle.

Setting.Name: Ticket::Frontend::AgentTicketZoom###Widgets###0350-TiqoraITSM
Setting.Description: Show the widget with the CIs Tiqora links to the ticket in the ticket zoom of the agent interface.

Setting.Name: Frontend::Module###AgentTiqoraITSMLink
Setting.Description: Frontend module registration for linking a ticket to a configuration item of Tiqora (AJAX). Does nothing unless TiqoraITSM::Linking::Enabled is on.

Hash.Item: Link a ticket to a configuration item of Tiqora.

Setting.Name: CustomerFrontend::Module###CustomerTiqoraITSM
Setting.Description: Frontend module registration for the customer page with the configuration items of Tiqora.

Hash.Item: Configuration items of the customer (from Tiqora).

Setting.Name: CustomerFrontend::Navigation###CustomerTiqoraITSM###002-TiqoraITSM
Setting.Description: Main menu item registration for the customer page with the configuration items of Tiqora.
